tools.name: check_policy_compliance
tools.description: Evaluate one HR scenario against the policy rules deterministically: which requirements apply, which are met, which approvals the request needs and what to do next, every requirement citing the policy section that backs it.

tools.name: get_policy_section
tools.description: Return the verbatim text of one section of a policy document, with its neighbours and siblings for context.

tools.name: list_policy_documents
tools.description: List the HR policy documents in the corpus with their topics, sizes and effective dates.

tools.name: search_policy_documents
tools.description: Semantic + lexical search over the 14 HR policy documents.
